需要用 JS 切换状态？ 查看 API 
const bot = document.querySelector("morph-bot");

bot.setState("thinking");
bot.setShape("hex");
await bot.playMorph("send");
await bot.playSequence(sequence);
await bot.performDialogue(dialogue);
